evidence: In the SOLDER PASTE EXAMPLE (SCALE: 15X) for DGK0008A, the horizontal dimension line above the pin-1 aperture is labelled '8X (1.4)' (the aperture width/long side), while the vertical dimension at the left is '8X (0.45)' (the short side). Other dimensions on the drawing are '6X (0.65)' (pitch) and '(4.4)' (overall span between the two aperture columns).

In Figure 8-5 (Second-Order Butterworth, 500-kHz Low-Pass Filter) the second series resistor, between the R1/C1 junction and the OPA365 inverting (-) input, is labelled 'R2 1.24kOhm'. R1 and R3 are both 549 Ohm. The 1.8k/19.5k values belong to Figure 8-6 (Sallen-Key) lower on the same page.

Figure 5-31 (VCC = 3.3 V) y-axis runs 3.00 to 3.30 with 0.05 gridlines; x-axis 0 to 200 mA with 50 mA gridlines. At the 100 mA vertical gridline the curve sits just below halfway between the 3.10 and 3.15 lines; pixel measurement against the labelled gridlines gives 3.120 V. Curve endpoints are ~3.24 V at 0 mA and ~3.04 V at ~150 mA.

In the LAND PATTERN EXAMPLE (SCALE:30X) for DRL0005A, the horizontal dimension at the bottom of the pad array, '(1.48)', has its arrowheads on the vertical dash-dot centrelines of the left-hand and right-hand pad columns. '5X (0.67)' is individual pad length, '5X (0.3)' pad width, '2X (0.5)' pitch, '(1)' the vertical span.

In the SOLDERMASK DETAILS panel, the left detail captioned 'NON SOLDER MASK DEFINED (PREFERRED)' carries the leader annotation '0.05 MAX AROUND'. The right detail, 'SOLDER MASK DEFINED', is the one annotated '0.05 MIN AROUND'.
The legend block inside the plot of Figure 6-16 reads: 'A VKA = Vref / B VKA = 5 V / C VKA = 10 V / D VKA = 15 Vf', with TA = 25 degC. So curve C is VKA = 10 V.

Figure 7-4 legend distinguishes a black 'Clock period = 1 RC' curve from a red 'Clock period = 2.5 RC' curve; axes are 0.5-4.5 V and 0-100% duty. At the 2.5 V gridline the red curve sits just above the 30% level; pixel measurement against the labelled 0/20/40 gridlines gives ~30.5%. The black 1 RC curve is near 70% at that point.

Figure 32 (VDD = 15 V), bottom Supply Current (mA/Ch) panel: for t < 0 (before the SHDN pulse falls) the trace is a flat line noticeably above the 0.75 gridline, measuring ~0.84 mA/Ch against the labelled 0.75 and 1 gridlines. During shutdown it drops to ~0.4 and then ~0.1 mA/Ch (the IDD(SHDN=0) level), and it returns to the same ~0.85 level after t = 120 us.

In the Section 8.2 Functional Block Diagram, the wide arrow from the differential input pair (the two MOS symbols fed by IN+/IN-) enters a first triangular gain symbol, whose apex connects by a short wire to a second triangular symbol, whose apex runs to the OUT terminal circle. Two triangles total; the 'Bias' block is a rectangle, not a triangle.
